statement: What the chain says about a token never changes which tokens an Account has: the token list is the proof body, so it changes only by a frame both sides signed. A snapshot for a token with no ledger waits in the Entity's chain facts (at most as many tokens as a proof body carries, the one past it told and dropped) and is applied when a signed frame gives the Account the ledger, on the committed state and on a pending frame's state.
source: Review A of PR 142 (B1: heads split when one side hears a new token first; B2: dust in 128 tokens makes the Account unsignable); account/proof/body.ts byToken and MAX_PROOF_TOKENS; R-REACK
